page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with italic passages marked; the Corvinus quotation runs from "à Deo" through "punire" in italics, and the hyphenated words "adver-satur", "pu-niat", "contradi-ctio", "De-um" and "bene-" are split at line ends as printed. Marginal note "Molina. c. 5. / fect. 8." is partly illegible: the section abbreviation "fect." is doubtful. The left margin note beside the line "adver-" reads "Corv. cont." Long s is normalised to s throughout (e.g. "est", "astruit", "suæ"). Line ends at "bene-" with the paragraph continuing on the next page.
